messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: pgd-High: host/gpu-node-45 heartbeat lost, kubelet NotReady. page fired at 3187659999
pagerduty: automated message: Incident pgd-High -> oncall pagerduty@redwood-inference.com
mira: acked. I’m on it — pulling node status now.
alex: I saw the page, switching to mobile. any customer impact yet?
mira: checking metrics — a handful of requests to dedicated pools routed to gpu-node-45 are failing fast with 502s/504s. Not widespread but one customer reported degraded throughput.
jonathan: pinging infra rails: are there any recent kernel/kernel-module updates on that rack?
ops-bot: reprovision logs: last syslogs from gpu-node-45 show repeated: 
```
kernel: CPU0: Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
[  123.456789] Call Trace:
[  123.456790]  dump_stack+0x45/0x6a
```

mira: kernel panic stack traces in syslog, then kubelet disappeared. node shows NotReady in cluster.
alex: can someone cordon it so scheduler stops putting new pods there?
mira: running: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-45` -> marked unschedulable :white_check_mark:
kevin: start drain? we should avoid evicting critical pods if they’re pinned.
mira: doing a selective drain: `kubectl drain gpu-node-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=30` — moving best-effort pods first. posting output:
```
node/gpu-node-45 cordoned
pod/worker-abc evicted
pod/sidecar-xyz evicted
```

jonathan: good. For dedicated-tenant A we saw a spike of 5% error rate during the panic window. routing fallback to other nodes limited impact.
alex: can we get serial console logs? I’ll try a remote-serial attach and check for hardware signs.
ops-bot: serial console stream: `cat /dev/console` -> shows repeated PCIe bus errors followed by kernel oops.
kevin: sounds like possible GPU PCIe fault. escalate to hardware team and open RMA.
mira: filing infra ticket, RMA requested, cc hw-team. Ticket ID INFRA-8791.
jonathan: while hw handles RMA, we need a mitigation plan: ensure remaining pods on that fleetwork are redistributed and can autoscale. any risk of modulation?
alex: routing policy updated: set nodeAffinity override for affected Dedicated pools to avoid that rack for 10m. also increasing replica counts where autoscaler allows.
kevin: confirm node has been drained fully?
mira: final drain status: `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-45` -> none except daemonsets.
jonathan: kubelet restart attempt? if kernel panic then node not recovering. we can try to soft-reboot from ipmi but prefer hw team direction.
ops-bot: executed: `ipmitool -H bmc-gpu-rack-7 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle` at 3187660200 -> node did not come back; no kubelet reconnect.
alex: escalation to L2 SRE @kevin — handing off remainder of mitigation and hw coord. I’m going offline for meeting in 5.
kevin: taking over. I’ll keep this thread for updates. immediate next steps: confirm customer-facing fallbacks are stable, keep autoscaler aggressive, keep RMA moving.
mira: note for post-incident: add a probe to detect repeated PCIe errors and escalate before kernel panic. also capture core dumps to s3 when possible.
kevin: logging a formal incident ticket: INC-2026-87, severity: high. action items assigned to hw-team (RMA), infra (kernel logs & coredumps), platform (routing fallbacks + autoscaler tuning).
jonathan: any longer-term mitigation? consider fencing nodes at first PCIe error threshold to avoid panic propagation.
kevin: agreed. I’ll draft rollback/mitigation playbook and add to runbook.
mira: handing off detailed notes to kevin — tl;dr: kernel panic -> kubelet lost -> autodrain/cordon succeeded -> partial customer impact limited via fallback -> RMA opened.
alex: :thumbsup: thanks all. I’ll update on-call rotation handoff ticket.
incident-bot: note: pagerduty incident pgd-High acknowledged by mira at 3187660005, escalated to kevin at 3187660300.
kevin: will stay on until hw confirms RMA shipment. switching channel to incident room for postmortem later.
jonathan: adding follow-up: create evals to detect degraded tail latency for dedicated pools and alert at 2% error increase.
kevin: actionables logged. closing on-call thread handoff at 3187661200 :white_check_mark:
__meta: generated by dataset-gen: unique autopager handoff thread about kernel panic + PCIe errors leading to node NotReady; includes commands, serial output and mitigation steps
